usage: Per arm: --env HOME=<arm>/home and --env CODEX_HOME=<arm>/home/.codex (create the directory first) plus credentials (--env CODEX_API_KEY=...). Codex reads user skills from $HOME/.agents/skills, so the moved HOME hides the real ones. Never add --dangerously-bypass-approvals-and-sandbox.

grader.status: Read-only judge run (sandbox read-only, ephemeral); the last message goes to a file. Smoke-graded on codex-cli 0.162.1 against a local fake Responses endpoint (a model_providers entry in the throwaway CODEX_HOME): the argv is accepted and the answer is read from the -o file and the agent_message event. The quality of a real model's judgment is not covered by that smoke.
grader.usage: Give the grader its own throwaway config like an arm: --env HOME=<root>/grader/home --env CODEX_HOME=<root>/grader/home/.codex plus credentials. Pin the model: --append-arg -m --append-arg <model>.
